rationale.edition: Both changed paths (from the complete changed_files.txt list) are web/src/enterprise/components/billings/BillingGroup.{vue,spec.ts}. That path sits under the enterprise web layer (web/src/enterprise/), and billing-group management is an enterprise-gated feature, so the path alone makes this enterprise. No prose/keyword needed to override it.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. No opt-out marker was passed (no tests-added label, trigger_comment.txt is empty), and this is not docs/CI-only: it edits a Vue component in web/src that a user sees and interacts with, so it is a user-facing change.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The desktop Remove action in the billing-group members table changes from an outline-destructive text button to a ghost-destructive icon button with new title and aria-label attributes, which is a user-visible control/interaction change that should be verified in a real browser (icon renders, tooltip/aria present, and the remove-member flow still works through the icon).
rationale.area: Billing-group member management is an enterprise Settings feature, and there is no dedicated Billing area in the matrix. The Management area is the closest existing home — it already holds enterprise settings specs (cipherKeys, logoManagement, model-pricing, settings-form-validation, edition-features).
rationale.group: The Management testfolder shard is the closest existing run_files group for an enterprise settings/billing spec. Because billing groups are enterprise-only, the Engineer must register the spec through the ENT overlay (ci_matrix.ent.json) — either appended to the shared Management group or as a new ENT shard.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff. The only test file changed is web/src/enterprise/components/billings/BillingGroup.spec.ts, which is a Vitest unit spec, not a Playwright E2E spec under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/. It does not count as existing E2E coverage for the new UI behavior.
